basis: UDP-20261007-01 first usable variant with expandable seams

rules.identity: New object: allocate tx/object/revision UUID4 once. Edit: immutable selected object/type and pinned base revision, allocate new tx/revision only; never silently change base, object identity or type. Full new immutable document, not a patch command.
rules.references: Picker reads bounded accepted Bank/history and freezes full (type,object_id,revision_id) tuples. Duplicate equality is exact tuple; distinct retained revisions of one object may coexist in ordered Collection. Never replace pins by latest, skip missing refs or recursively expand Collection cycles. Commit remains final reference/CAS authority.
rules.provenance: Visible explicit author/origin/nullable identity/model; no provider/author inference. New Entity/Collection/Annotation defaults unknown until explicitly selected. Metadata-only Asset edit preserves original provenance; explicit replacement captures new source provenance with declared unknown defaults, source_locator nullable, captured_at frozen new capture time; no inherited obsolete acquisition claims. Source_ref remains null in R1. Current fields/refs are copied unless explicitly edited; producer describes this app preparation, not content authorship.
rules.base_snapshot: Read and validate requested supported pinned base document once. Freeze canonical private BASE.json snapshot and its SHA/ref/commit metadata; hash labels mean normalized returned document, not an unexposed raw retained JSON BLOB. Changing head afterward affects commit CAS, not this frozen input.
rules.asset_original: Metadata-only bytes Asset revision uses accepted pinned bank.original export; reopen returned private output via existing private File guards, verify expected exact length/hash/identity while streaming into immutable prepared payload. SelectedOriginal intentionally rejects app-owned output paths and is only for explicitly selected external replacement. Preserve display filename/media type; transport file_path may be normalized. Original replacement is explicit bytes→bytes or locator→locator; retain old versions/originals. No in-place BLOB edits or external input permission repair.
rules.prepared_protocol: Separate object-authoring journal: INTENT plus optional BASE plus SEAL, outside strict producer source inventory. Freeze tx/revision/base, new full doc, exact payload/descriptors/profile/time before seal. Source inventory only DRAFT.json+declared docs/payload. Every control/payload write exclusive/flush/readback; seal pins INTENT/BASE/DRAFT/files. Unsealed partial stays INCOMPLETE; sealed complete input finishes same bytes/IDs without Bank/original reselection.
rules.composition: Separate eighth existing disjoint object_authoring root, alongside unchanged seven creation roots. Validate all8 then pass exactly6 roots to accepted base.Backend and7 to legacy creation.Workspace; do not pass unknown eighth role to them. Reuse existing authoring/LOCK for shared source mutations across old/new paths. Hold it exactly once; new locked actions invoke six-root Backend or Publisher directly, not legacy locked Backend recursively. Single UI worker/cancel channel and tx+generation+workspace context isolation.
rules.retry_conflict: Publish/save/receipt explicit. Publication/prepared journal never claims Bank acceptance. STALE_BASE retains exact failed intent and shows conflict; exact retry remains same base/IDs. Explicit new edit reads current head and allocates new tx/revision; no automatic rebase or merge. UNKNOWN uses actual receipt and pinned manifest retry; journal damage never hides accepted Bank receipt.
rules.limits: Versioned first profile, finite UTF-8/JSON actual bytes, conservative reservation before allocation, streamed IO; no persisted truncation or automatic GC. Quotas declared per journal plus entire shared managed-source root, not a claimed global Bank size. Shared LOCK serializes old/new admission; old profile stays unchanged.
rules.ui: Visible New Entity/New Collection/targeted Annotation and Edit selected version; read-only type/object/base/tx/revision IDs, bounded field lists and typed pinned picker with add/remove/order controls. Explicit prepare→publish→save/receipt and preserved incomplete/conflict/unknown. No mandatory raw schema/JSON entry. Older version stays browsable; choosing it as edit base can yield visible stale conflict.
rules.scope: Owned synthetic inputs/windows/processes only. No runtime implementation in card review, real Bank/install, canonical/accepted code/DDL changes, Source/Run/provider/network/Watch, identity merge or full release acceptance.

canonical_limits_unchanged: 64MiB/file256MiB/package; exact current schema/limits/publisher/read/import policies remain owners. These additional caps are implementation proposals, not user permanent maxima.

native_before_adoption_gates.required: Actual eight-root configuration plus shared old/new LOCK, two processes, OS-exit release, no nested-lock deadlock, quota admission, unchanged legacy creation workflow.

Pinned base and Bank-original private export→capture path, real guards/identity/hash/ACL/races, readable external replacement under SelectedOriginal;64MiB supported capture/reuse at selected work/time budgets and64MiB+1 safe refusal.
